source.cells: SFM 1000; Chip load .00015; ADOC .14 x Dia; RDOC 1 x Dia

vendor_notes: All posted speed and feed parameters are suggested starting values that may be increased given optimal setup conditions.
Chip loads reflect uncoated cutters and may be increased 10%-20% if coated.
For ferrous materials with hardness <= 28 Rc, chip loads can be increased 10%-20%.
WARNING: Cutting tools may shatter under improper use. Government regulations require use of safety glasses and other appropriate safety equipment in the vicinity of use.
rows.notes: Ball-nose end mill (profile 'Ball' on the Harvey tool page; corner radius = DC/2). Chart diameter column mapped to the Harvey part of the listed series whose cutter diameter equals the column header (flute count and length of cut from that part's catalog page). The sheet prints no effective-diameter, scallop/stepover or ball-specific depth rule; chip loads are listed by cutter diameter. Values read from the pdftotext -layout text and checked against the rendered page. Chart diameter columns [0.375, 0.5] have no catalog part in series 743xx/744xx and are not emitted.

If less than minimum Axial or Radial DOC values are used, increased feed rates are possible.

rows.notes: Ball-nose end mill (profile 'Ball' on the Harvey tool page; corner radius = DC/2). Chart diameter column mapped to the Harvey part of the listed series whose cutter diameter equals the column header (flute count and length of cut from that part's catalog page). The sheet prints no effective-diameter, scallop/stepover or ball-specific depth rule; chip loads are listed by cutter diameter. Values read from the pdftotext -layout text and checked against the rendered page. Variable-pitch inferred from the product name "Variable Helix"; coating code C6 = AlTiN Nano per Harvey coatings page. Chart also lists a Max chip-load row (a cap), not emitted. Chart diameter columns [0.015, 0.047, 0.312] have no catalog part (with the stated flute count) in series 7267xx-C6/8145xx-C6/9443xx-C6 and are not emitted.

rows.notes: Corner-radius end mill (profile 'Corner Radius' on the Harvey tool page; the radius is that part's catalog corner radius). Chart diameter column mapped to the Harvey part of the listed series whose cutter diameter equals the column header (flute count and length of cut from that part's catalog page). The sheet prints no effective-diameter, scallop/stepover or ball-specific depth rule; chip loads are listed by cutter diameter. Values read from the pdftotext -layout text and checked against the rendered page. Variable-pitch from the product name "Variable Pitch"; coating code C10 = Ti Nano. The chart prints one chip load per diameter for the 3x and 5x LOC tools of the series; the 3x part is used. Chart diameter columns [0.09375] have no catalog part in series 7109xx-C10/7110xx-C10/7111xx-C10/7112xx-C10/7113xx-C10/7114xx-C10/7115xx-C10/7116xx-C10 and are not emitted. Finishing RDOC printed as 4%-6% Diameter; ae uses the 5% midpoint. ADOC printed "Up to Max LOC", so ap = LOC of this part.
